source_notes: ICAEW publishes the module list, exam format and pass mark on its CFAB exam-modules page, and syllabus/topic detail across its CFAB and Next Generation ACA study-resources pages, but not full past papers beyond limited sample/specimen material. Stage tests and the mock are original questions in ICAEW's real objective-test/multi-task style; every numeric answer, including every UK tax computation, was computed with Python against the live-fetched 2026/27 tax figures.
